reviewFlags.title: Inventory count and roll-forward differ
reviewFlags.detail: Inventory & COGS schedule row 44: 80,000 opening + 459,000 purchases - 405,000 COGS - 22,000 write-down = 112,000 closing (D048/D075/D086). Physical count shows 121,000; the 9,000 eur gap is not recognised and is disclosed as an open item (see D075/D091).

reviewFlags.title: Supplier payable roll-forward corrected
reviewFlags.detail: Closing supplier payables are EUR 126,000 as independently confirmed in file 06. Purchases less payments, EUR 81,000, is the increase in debt. The opening payable is inferred as EUR 45,000 so that EUR 45,000 + EUR 459,000 - EUR 378,000 = EUR 126,000. The opening ledger was not supplied. Student basis: 06 Purchases reports independently confirmed closing supplier balances of 25000 + 28000 + 14000 + 59000 = 126000 eur. 02 Bank shows supplier payments of 105000 + 92000 + 81000 + 100000 = 378000 eur, while current purchases are 459000 eur. Purchases less payments, 81000 eur, is the increase in debt. The missing opening supplier ledger is resolved by inference: 126000 closing - 459000 purchases + 378000 payments = 45000 opening payables.

reviewFlags.title: Approval of corrected accounts
reviewFlags.detail: Management's deck claims profit 312000 eur and cash 186000 eur, both contradicted by stronger evidence. The corrected balance sheet has assets 531000 eur, liabilities 406000 eur and equity 125000 eur. Supplier payables close at the independently confirmed 126000 eur. Since current purchases of 459000 eur less payments of 378000 eur increase supplier debt by 81000 eur, an opening payable of 45000 eur is inferred: 45000 + 459000 - 378000 = 126000. Opening assets are 330000 eur and opening liabilities are 160000 eur (loan 100000, payroll payable 15000 and inferred supplier payable 45000), so opening equity is 170000 eur. Closing equity is 170000 + 65000 profit - 110000 distributions = 125000 eur. Closing liabilities are 126000 supplier + 32000 payroll + 25000 legal + 2000 interest + 131000 loan + 90000 deposits = 406000 eur. The remaining disclosed points are the 9000 eur inventory gap and missing insurance data.
